text:
incident-bot: [PAGER] sev=high /— unusually high auth failures + outbound object uploads detected from edge-proxy cluster in us-east-1. Pattern: token reuse + high-rate PUTs to an outside bucket. Trigger at 2026-04-02T03:22:08Z. Paging oncall.

emma (oncall): Ack. I'm on it. Joining logs and opening bridge. ETA 2m.

jon (eng-sre): quick snapshot: ~900 auth failures (401/403) in last 10m tied to svc token id `svc-deploy-gt2`. src IPs: 54.86.12.9, 3.122.44.200, 52.45.99.13. Also see PUTs to https://storage-extern.example.com/incoming-rdw.

maya (eng-infra): I'm pushing a temporary denylist for those IPs at the edge and adding a WAF rule to block the upload path. Also preparing to disable the service token in IAM; need confirmation before revoke.

emma (oncall): Proceed with revoke, keep a primary contact for downstream jobs. I'm on bridge: https://meet.example/inc-1767778888

carla (security): Prioritize searching all objects uploaded in the past 6h for sensitive patterns (email, creditcard-like, ssn, api_key). If matches found, escalate to legal immediately.

jon (eng-sre): sample logs:
```
2026-04-02T03:21:58Z edge-proxy-12 PUT /v1/store 200 token=svc-deploy-gt2 src=54.86.12.9 ua=rdw-uploader/2.0
2026-04-02T03:22:05Z edge-proxy-07 auth failed token=svc-deploy-gt2 src=3.122.44.200
```

maya (eng-infra): token `svc-deploy-gt2` disabled in IAM across prod orgs. Rolling key rotation to related service accounts. Snapshotting current active keys for audit.

tom (customer-success): Any sign of customer-facing errors? Monitoring shows a bump in generation errors on /embeddings and /generate for a small handful of tenants. I'll draft a short heads-up to potentially impacted accounts once we confirm scope.

ops-bot: Automated action: object retrieval from external sink saved to internal quarantine bucket `quarantine/1767778888/`. 24 objects pulled so far.

carla (security): Running content scan on quarantined objects now. Running fast regex for emails, 16-digit numbers, bearer tokens, and env var patterns. Will post results.

jon (eng-sre): I'm watching for replay attempts. Blocking observed IPs stopped PUTs. Still seeing low-level auth failure noise from unrelated IP ranges; looks like background scanning.

emma (oncall): Handoff request: I need to drop for a meeting in 30m. Can someone take watch and finish rotation verification?

maya (eng-infra): I can take the next 2hr watch. I'll confirm rotated tokens accepted and run smoke tests against the main customer routes.

carla (security): Initial scan: 24 objects — no obvious email or SSN patterns in quick pass. Found a few API key-like strings (short tokens) in 3 objects. Marking those as suspected secrets. Escalating to legal for assessment.

legal-amy: Looking. If those tokens map to customer secrets we need to follow disclosure policy. Coordinate with CS on timing and content.

tom (customer-success): Preparing narrow outreach template. Will not send until security confirms customer mapping. Prefer staged contact to smallest affected set.

maya (eng-infra): Rotation verification: new tokens rolled, auth success on smoke routes, no new PUTs seen for 20m. I'll keep the denylist and WAF rule for another hour and then reassess.

ops-bot: Monitoring: edge-proxy PUT rate back to baseline. Alert suppression will hold for 45m pending no new anomalies.

carla (security): Deep scan queued (regex + entropy checks) — currently ~15% complete. If we confirm secrets, we'll mark severity escalate and prepare notification draft.

emma (oncall): Thanks. Switching status to contained -> monitoring. Creating incident ticket RDW-INC-1767778888 and assigning eng-sre, infra, security owners. Postmortem due EOD next day.

maya (eng-infra): I'll post a short runbook update with the rotation steps we executed and verification commands. Also saving the list of affected service principals for audit.

tom (customer-success): Standing by for final confirmation to message customers.

carla (security): Deep scan result: 3 objects contained short token-like strings. We traced one to an internal job (non-customer) and two map to a small set of customer tenants (IDs redacted). Legal advised to prepare notification.

legal-amy: Drafting notification. Recommend 72-hour window for outreach once CS approves the list and timing. We'll follow the incident notification checklist.

emma (oncall): Closing bridge in 10m if no new findings. For now: contained -> monitoring. Thanks team. Will post final summary when legal/CS confirm outreach plan.
